mu_name_from: MuMain maps MODEL_ARMOR + i to ArmorMale{i+1}; file 4 is index 3, which openmu names Legendary.
why_this_one: Apostle Devin's reward in Devias (docs/devin-quest.md). The body armour alone; the rest of the set is not built.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_gladiator: The Magic Gladiator's too, as every first-class knight's or wizard's piece but a helm is (OpenMU ArmorInitializerBase.cs:330-336; MuMain's item.bmd RequireClass[3]).
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 1, 0, 0 - the Dark Wizard alone. No agility, as on the Sphinx set.

sheet_from: Data/Player/upper_13m.OZJ (128x128) and hide_m.jpg, from MuMain's Player tree at c0d74c4 - the plain ArmorMale04.bmd, not the CW_/HDK_ variants. The .bmd names upper_13m.jpg and hide_m.jpg; 147 of the 163 triangles are on the robe and 16 on hide.
sheet_note: upper_13m is a deep blue robe-cuirass with gold filigree in raised bands over the chest and collar, mean (56, 46, 54): blue cloth dark in its folds, the gold a small part of the area, black hair painted down the right-hand side where the back of the collar is, and pale pink margins. hide_m is MU capping the openings, a solid black square, as on ArmorMale10.
material_note: Five islands, a robe with a plated mantle. Island 0 (92 triangles) is the chest and shoulder mantle, blue enamel under raised gold filigree, and island 1 (22) the lower band of the same plate: both plate_steel. Islands 2 and 3 are the sleeves, drawn on the sheet's black right-hand column, and 4 a single triangle beside them: cloth, as the Sphinx bodysuit is.
material_overrides_why: The Dragon Armor's override, for the same fault: at the library's values the sheet (mean 56, f0 lifted 0.195 -> 0.52) came back grey chrome with its blue gone and a grainy mottle. Desaturation 1.0 keeps the blue and the gold, f0 0.42 at 0.70 of the art keeps the filigree legible, roughness 0.55 takes the mirror off.

upscale.why: 3x at detail 0.35 as on the Dragon Armor: a dark 128-square sheet at 0.65 grows generated grain.
